title: Ninth House
author: Leigh Bardugo
summary: A young woman with a history of trauma is offered a place at Yale on the condition that she monitors the university's secret societies, whose rituals involve real, dangerous magic. When a girl is found dead, she has to work out what happened.
readIf: you want a grim, adult dark-academia fantasy with a gripping mystery and a fiercely damaged heroine.
skipIf: you are sensitive to sexual violence and drug abuse, which are both depicted frankly.

pairings.reason: A classic of the elite-campus murder mystery, similarly moody and morally rotten, without the magic.
Same author's younger, more caper-driven fantasy for a quicker, less brutal read.
Another dark fantasy where a haunted woman investigates a killing that points toward powerful people.
